verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Agent Wallets with spending policies and compliance guardrails. That limits what an agent can spend onchain, which is an adjacent control, not the ability to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials. Nothing in the pack describes API key scopes, restricted keys, or per-agent credential permissions, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
